scope: rankings / progression / multiplayer correctness; no production edits
rationale: Durable storage and readable records are credible. Reconnect gives a competitive advantage, identity attribution can change mid-round, and two ordinary reconnect paths fail. Career retention is stored but incompletely exposed. Passing broad regressions does not cover these edge cases.

defects.title: Reconnect bypasses respawn and restores combat resources
defects.reproduction: Keep a second human in the room. Kill or damage pilot A, disconnect A, reconnect with the same profileToken and join the same code before respawnAt. Targeted probe used tick:false and a dead fixture with health=1, energy=0, respawnAt=3, time=0; join/disconnect traversed real sockets.
defects.observed: Rejoined pilot was alive with health=100, energy=100, respawnAt=0 and protectedUntil=1.5 at time=0. Kills=4/deaths=2 remained intact; departed entry was consolidated.
defects.impact: A player can evade the three-second death penalty or repeatedly heal/recharge by reconnecting without losing accrued score.
defects.fix: Restore authoritative combat state and remaining respawn/protection timers for a reconnecting profile; do not unconditionally spawn it.
defects.verification: Disconnect/rejoin living damaged and dead pilots; assert no resource gain or shortened death timer.

defects.title: Repeated join can reassign accumulated stats to another profile
defects.reproduction: Join as token A, accumulate round counters, wait >400ms, then emit join to the same room on the same socket using token C. End the round and record its authoritative recap. Probe used deterministic 4 kills, 2 deaths, 430 damage, 20 fired, 7 hit.
defects.observed: Same player object kept four kills but profileId changed. RankingStore credited C with four kills and score 686; A had no record.
defects.impact: Identity is mutable mid-round and attribution is lost. This does not permit taking over an unknown bearer token; it permits transferring stats between tokens the caller supplies.
defects.fix: Bind a connected participant to its canonical profile identity. Reject identity changes while participating, or close the old participation explicitly without transferring counters.
defects.verification: A repeated join with a different token must not change ownership of existing counters.

defects.title: Sole-human connection loss destroys the room before automatic rejoin
defects.reproduction: Create a room with one human and bots. Disconnect the human, reconnect with the same token, and join the original room code.
defects.observed: Room was deleted immediately; rejoin returned Room not found. Check the code or create a new room.
defects.impact: The normal solo-online-with-bots flow cannot recover from a transient disconnect; in-progress stats disappear. This is an explicit cleanup behavior in current tests, but conflicts with the client promise of rejoining the room.
defects.fix: Use a bounded empty-room reconnect grace period, distinguishing intentional leave from transport loss where practical.
defects.verification: Reconnect within grace resumes room/counters; an expired abandoned room is cleaned up.

defects.title: Reconnect during intermission loses the local recap view
defects.reproduction: Complete a round with another human connected, disconnect/rejoin with the same profileToken during the ten-second recap.
defects.observed: Authoritative recap still contains old socket ID. Rejoin supplies a new socket ID; local recap lookup has no match although profileId matches.
defects.impact: UI takes the No pilot statistics for this round branch despite a recorded round. Stored career totals are not lost.
defects.fix: Resolve online recap identity by canonical profileId with socket fallback for practice.
defects.verification: Same-token intermission reconnect displays original kills, score and XP without adding another match.

testResults.result: PASS: actual completed socket round appears in Overall/Canopy, Foundry empty, local identity highlighted, zero captured errors

verified.durability: 9 RankingStore tests passed: durable reopen, idempotency, validation, bot exclusion, stable ordering, last-ten history, overflow atomicity, concurrent writes, IO failure/retry and corrupt-storage refusal. Online restart integration also passed. File/directory fsync and atomic rename are present. Docker now copies rankings and compose mounts named rankings volume; configuration inspected, container restart not independently exercised.
verified.scoring: Server-owned counters; kill 100 + floor(damage*.2) - death 25 + win 250, clamped >=0. XP 25 + kill 40 + floor(damage/10) + win 150. Browser one-kill/24-damage record: score 354, XP 217. Successful grenade projectile counted once; suicide counters remain nonnegative.
verified.rejoin: Same-token counters and departed consolidation passed when another human remains. SYS-1/3/4 limit correctness.
verified.mapRotation: Exact four-map cycle independently passed; existing tests exercise resets and safe spawns across eight rounds.
verified.retention: Lifetime/per-map totals, XP-derived level and last10 persist and rebuild. Browser token warning is accurate. Current UI exposes only career rounds/wins/score/XP; no last10 or level rendering found.

limitations.detail: Recap says View your history in Pilot records, but records shows only aggregates. Stored last10, level and career accuracy have no UI. Add recent-round entries and visible progression before claiming a strong return-play loop.
Every save stringifies the entire unbounded ledger; startup replays all rounds. Single-writer small-server design, not a demonstrated production-scale fault. No load or power-loss test performed.
Completed private and bot-filled online rounds share cumulative score boards. No skill rating or opponent-quality normalization; do not portray this as verified competitive matchmaking.

visuallyInspected: browser.screenshot (PNG embedded in this JSON; independently captured and visually inspected)
evidence.matrix: All 14 available r1 JSON receipts inspected: consoleErrors/pageErrors/failedRequests empty. All 11 matrix outputs present and matrix/capture processes ended before own browser capture. Only recap PNG visually inspected from that matrix; no claims for uninspected world screenshots.
evidence.visualAssessment: Recap has readable eight-stat layout and explicit practice exclusion. Actual leaderboard has clear scope tabs, legible rows, local highlight and honest token disclaimer. Two-row desktop screenshot does not prove long-table or mobile leaderboard quality.
